name: council
description: Run council reviews only when explicitly requested. Council keeps moderation in-session, sends exact prompts and complete bounded material to every selected high-effort reviewer, preserves mandatory synthesis headings, reports progress only through Council progress lines, avoids shell-based agent probing, proactively cleans stale agents before fan-out, attempts the full safe reviewer roster, retries no-receiver capacity misses, handles follow-up challenges without raw reviewer leaks, and requires explicit approval for runs above 6 reviewers.
